title: Pure Morphtronic
summary: Pure Morphtronic battle-position Synchro and Link combo deck, featuring the modern 2022 support and generic Synchro/Link bosses. Morphtronics possess split effects based on whether they are in Attack Position or Defense Position, creating looping revivals with Telefon and climbing into high-Level Synchro negates.

summary.title: Starters
points: Morphtronic Telefon gains LP and revives a Morphtronic monster from your GY in Attack Position without a once-per-turn restriction, or excavates and mills a Morphtronic in Defense Position.
Morphtronic Celfon excavates cards from the top of the Deck in Attack Position to Special Summon an excavated Morphtronic monster regardless of Level.
Morphtronic Smartfon banishes a Morphtronic from the GY to Special Summon itself as a Tuner, then excavates cards to add an excavated Morphtronic card to hand.
Morphtronic Converter equips to a Morphtronic to swap an Attack Position Machine for another Morphtronic from the Deck, and searches Morphtronic Spells/Traps if sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Morphtronic Telefon + Morphtronic Converter
steps: Normal Summon Morphtronic Telefon in Attack Position.
Equip Morphtronic Converter to Telefon, activating Converter's effect to send Telefon to the GY and Special Summon Morphtronic Scannen from your Deck.
Converter triggers in the GY to search Morphtronic Impact Return or Morphtronic Map from your Deck.
Activate Scannen in Attack Position to banish a Morphtronic from your hand, searching a Morphtronic Spell/Trap and reviving Morphtronic Telefon in Attack Position.
Telefon in Attack Position rolls a die to revive a second Telefon from your GY, initiating Synchro climbing into Morphtronic Earfon, Coral Dragon, or Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon negates an opponent's monster effect as a Quick Effect and gains ATK, while also gaining ATK equal to the opposing monster's ATK when battling a Level 5 or higher monster.
Morphtronic Earfon is a Level 4 Synchro that treats a monster as a Tuner and equips itself from the GY to a Synchro Monster to grant it multiple attacks.
Kuibelt the Blade Dragon destroys a card on the field upon Synchro Summon.
Desert Locusts forces the opponent to discard a card on summon and can Synchro Summon during their turn.
S:P Little Knight and I:P Masquerena provide flexible Quick Effect removal and disruption.
Morphtronic Slingen Tributes another Morphtronic monster in Attack Position to target and destroy a card on the field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Morphtronic Converter enables rapid Deck recruitment by trading an on-field Machine and searches when sent to the GY.
Morphtronic Impact Return targets up to two opponent Spells/Traps to shuffle into the Deck, and banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon a Morphtronic from GY or banishment.
Morphtronic Map increases ATK every time a monster changes battle position and revives a Morphtronic from GY when destroyed.
Morphtronic Accelerator returns a Morphtronic from hand to Deck to destroy a card on the field and draw a card.
Morphtronic Forcefield negates an opponent's Spell/Trap that would destroy a card on the field and adds a Morphtronic card from Deck to hand.
